overview: Shadeweaver’s Thicket is the first wild region encountered by travelers leaving Shar Vahl. It blends savanna grasslands with dense thicket forests and cavern mouths leading toward Netherbian Lair.
history: Vah Shir hunters established patrol routes to protect Shar Vahl.
Grimling raiders began crossing into the thicket from Grimling Forest.
Netherbian burrow faults opened beneath the thicket after seismic activity.
Seru scouts attempted to map the region but were driven out.
Corrupted wildlife emerged from deeper thicket shadows.
regionHooks: A Vah Shir clan reports Grimling incursions.
Netherbian burrowers erupt from new faultlines.
A corrupted thicket beast stalks night trails.
Seru scouts attempt to reclaim lost mapping posts.
